# @aponiajs/schematics

> The Nest-shaped schematic collection an Aponia project names in `aponia-cli.json`.

## What this package publishes

- `collection.json`: the verified schematic names, aliases, factory paths, and schema paths.
- `schema.json` per schematic: the options the CLI validates.
- A plain-function factory per schematic: `(options) => { files }`.

## Schematics

`application`, `class|cl`, `controller|co`, `decorator|d`, `filter|f`,
`gateway|ga`, `guard|gu`, `interceptor|itc`, `interface|itf`, `middleware|mi`,
`module|mo`, `pipe|pi`, `provider|pr`, `service|s`, `resolver|r`,
`configuration|config`, `library|lib`, `sub-app|app`, `resource|res`, and
`upgrade|update`. There is no `enum`, `test`, or `dto` schematic.
